Spotlight.Gm: the spotlight swings to the GM: {name}

DeathMove.RiskAll: Risk It All: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}, matching: every Hit Point and Stress cleared

Plan.Title: Daggerheart
Plan.Hint: How the GM runs this fight: the Fear it starts with, and how freely it spends Fear to bring more adversaries into the spotlight.
Plan.FearHint: The Fear the GM has going in. It starts as the world's Fear, and Make it So writes back what the fight leaves.
Plan.SpendingHint: On a GM turn, one adversary takes the spotlight. The GM can spend a Fear for each one more.
Plan.sparingHint: One more adversary in a GM turn, only while the GM holds more than 4 Fear.
Plan.steadyHint: One more adversary in a GM turn, while the GM holds more than 1 Fear.
Plan.freeHint: As many more adversaries as there is Fear for.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's next roll against a foe is to succeed after it sizes that foe up (Analyze with Knowledge, or Perceive with Instinct, against the foe's Difficulty; on a success, never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 3× a sure thing more often than not. Default 2.4×: what it takes for that one roll to make up for the action it cost.

FFDAGGERHEART.Helped: a d6 on their next roll

Sprint.Missed: tries to sprint (Agility, {note}) and gets no farther than Close range
Sprint.Adversary: closes in, up to Very Far range
